CVE-2026-45829.description: Pre-auth RCE via HuggingFace model loading. Unauthenticated attacker can execute arbitrary code by sending malicious embedding-function configuration.
CVE-2026-45829.exploit_path: POST /api/v2/tenants/{tenant}/databases/{db}/collections with trust_remote_code=True and malicious HuggingFace model
CVE-2026-45829.mitigation: Isolate ChromaDB from internet. Enable auth. Pin to specific model versions.

CVE-2024-39720.description: OOM read via malformed GGUF file. Attacker crashes application through CreateModel route.

CVE-2024-39721.description: DoS via /dev/random path read. CreateModelHandler reads arbitrary files including /dev/random.

CVE-2024-39722.description: Path traversal in api/push route. Exposes server file system structure.

CVE-2024-28224.description: DNS rebinding allows unauthorized API access - chat with LLM, delete models, DoS.
CVE-2024-28224.exploit_path: DNS rebinding attack against Ollama API
CVE-2024-28224.mitigation: Upgrade to Ollama >= 0.1.29. Bind to localhost only.

CVE-2024-27132.description: XSS in MLflow templates leads to client-side RCE when running untrusted recipes.
CVE-2024-27132.exploit_path: XSS in MLflow recipe template variables → RCE in Jupyter Notebook

CVE-2024-27133.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in MLflow leads to RCE.
CVE-2024-27133.exploit_path: XSS via dataset table fields → client-side RCE
CVE-2024-27133.mitigation: Sanitize all user inputs. Upgrade MLflow.

CVE-2025-24357.description: Arbitrary code execution via model weights download in hf_model_weights_iterator.
CVE-2025-24357.mitigation: Pin model versions. Verify model integrity.
